title: Multicollinearity in Regression: Understanding the Dummy Variable Trap

cues.en: Bearable trap last time we learn how to create dummy variables to replace our categorical predictors state in the model.
cues.zh: 虛擬變數陷阱。上一堂學會建立虛擬變數，替換模型中的 State 類別預測因子。

cues.en: We also discussed that you can never include both dummy variables at the same time.
cues.zh: 也提到，兩個虛擬變數不能同時全部加入。

cues.en: In our example we admitted the California dummy.
cues.zh: 在例子中，我們省略了 California。

cues.en: Now why is that.
cues.zh: 為什麼？

cues.en: What will happen if we include the second dummy variable in the model as well.
cues.zh: 如果把第二個虛擬變數也加入，會怎樣？

cues.en: Let's see then tension here is that you're basically duplicating a variable.
cues.zh: 問題在於，基本上是重複加入相同資訊。

cues.en: This is because D2 always equals to one minus D1 the phenomenon where one or several independent variables
cues.zh: 因為 d2 永遠等於 1-d1。在線性迴歸中，一個或多個自變數

cues.en: in a linear regression predict another is called multicollinearity as a result of this effect the model cannot distinguish between the effects of D-1 from the effects from of D2.
cues.zh: 能預測另一個自變數的現象，叫做多重共線性。模型因此無法區分 d1 與 d2 各自的效果。

cues.en: And therefore it won't work properly.
cues.zh: 所以不能正常運作。

cues.en: And this is called the dummy variable trap.
cues.zh: 這就叫虛擬變數陷阱。

cues.en: If you do the math behind this scenario you will see that the real problem is that you cannot have these three elements in your model at the same time the constant and both the dummy variables.
cues.zh: 如果推導數學，就會發現真正的問題，是不能同時在模型中保留常數，以及兩個完整的虛擬變數。

cues.en: I will leave it up to you to figure this one out on your own and let me know if you have any trouble .
cues.zh: 你可以試著自行推導，有問題再告訴我。

cues.en: I'll definitely help here.
cues.zh: 我一定會協助。

cues.en: So to sum up whenever you're building a model always admit to one dummy variable and this applies irrespective of the number of dummy variables they are in that specific dummy set.
cues.zh: 所以，建立模型時，要從同一組虛擬變數中省略一個，不論該組共有多少個。

cues.en: If you have nine then you should only include eight if you have 100.
cues.zh: 有九個就只放八個；有 100 個，

cues.en: Then you should only include 99 of them.
cues.zh: 就只放 99 個。

cues.en: Also note that if you have two sets of dummy variables then you need to apply the same rule to each set.
cues.zh: 如果有兩組虛擬變數，則每一組都必須套用相同規則。

cues.en: For instance we could have had a column which specifies the industry in which the companies operate to build the model in that case we would have had to perform exactly the same steps and create another
cues.zh: 例如，資料裡也可能有一欄表示公司產業，建立模型時就需要重複相同步驟，

cues.en: set of dummy variables specifically for that column.
cues.zh: 替產業欄建立另一組虛擬變數。

cues.en: And then we would include all but one of those dummy variables in our actual model.
cues.zh: 而這組在加入模型時，也要省略一個。

cues.en: I hope this explanation was useful and you will never fall victim of the dummy variable trapped in your modeling.
cues.zh: 希望這份說明有幫助，讓你建模時不會掉進虛擬變數陷阱。

cues.en: Next time we're going to cover the different ways you can build a model.
cues.zh: 下一堂要介紹建立模型的不同方法。

cues.en: We will learn all about backward elimination of forward selection stepwise regression and much more .
cues.zh: 包括向後淘汰、向前選取、逐步迴歸等等。

cues.en: Going to be an exciting tutorial and I look forward to seeing you then.
cues.zh: 會是很精彩的一堂，期待見到你。
